research_question: What peak GPU memory and throughput does stage3_lora training of MedGemma 27B multimodal (google/medgemma-27b-it) reach on one B200, does the loss decrease, and does the trainable-only checkpoint round-trip?
hypothesis: Peak memory stays at or below the estimate for this configuration (ESTIMATE.md: 73.6 GB, 1x B200, r=16 for LoRA; estimate, not measurement) with at least 10% headroom; loss over the last 20 steps is below the first 20.
measurement_goals: loss decreases (mean of last 20 steps < first 20)

model.license: Health AI Developer Foundations Terms of Use

stop_rules: non-finite loss: stop, keep diagnostics, no automatic retry
CUDA OOM: stop; do not silently change batch or sequence length
peak memory above 90% of GPU memory
any data or temporal-leakage audit failure

artifacts.retention: keep the last 2 checkpoints and run.json; deletion of evidence needs human approval

approval_note: Tier-3/4 runs (beyond 1 GPU or 60 min, including any 8x B200 or ~27B full run) require explicit human approval recorded in docs/DECISIONS.md before launch.
